_comment: Outlets from Alyssa's ranked list that publish no RSS feed. Built by src/scrapers/sitefeed.py into docs/feeds/*.xml and read by config.github.json via file:// URLs. Replaces the lapsed rss.app account at zero cost.

sites.name: Mansion Global
sites._note: Mansion Global returns HTTP 401 to GitHub Actions runner IPs on every entry point, including the homepage, though it loads fine from a residential IP. Disabled until we pick a workaround. Combined rank 9, 101 all-time stories, so worth revisiting.
